item.title: Python - replace long if/elif chain with dict mappings
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Python - Avoiding long if/elif chain with dictionary mappings
Three ways to handle the keys of a Pong game: a long if/elif chain, a dictionary that maps each key to a function, and a dictionary that maps each key to the arguments of one update. From the Pong mini-project of Rice University’s “An Introduction to Interactive Programming in Python” on Coursera, written in CodeSkulptor with its simplegui module.
Course: https://www.coursera.org/learn/interactive-python-1
CodeSkulptor: https://py2.codeskulptor.org/
